text:
mika: seeing a weird eviction wave in eu-west1 this morning — lots of tiny gpu pods getting PREEMPTED even though warmpools are full. suspect something about labels/annotations that used to pack them is drifting. anyone seen this?

alex: saw it on the cluster dashboard, evictions spike ~06:12 UTC. most evicted pods are tiny inference jobs. their events show 'failed scheduling: NodeAffinity/NodeSelector mismatch' even though node labels look right when I checked a few.

alex: example pod events:
```
Events:
  Type     Reason             Age   From               Message
  ----     ------             ----  ----               -------
  Normal   Scheduled          12m   default-scheduler  Successfully assigned gpu/inf-xyz to node-eu-12
  Warning  FailedPlacement     11m   kube-scheduler     NodeAffinity/NodeSelector mismatch: node missing required annotation "redwood/gpu-cohort"
  Normal   Started            11m   kubelet            Started container
  Warning  Preempted           5m   kubelet            Preempted: insufficient contiguous slots
```

priyanka: ran a quick grep across node sync logs and found the label-syncer rollout to eu-west1 earlier this morning normalized annotations differently. nodes had `redwood/gpu-cohort: gpu-v2` previously, syncer 2.1.0 now writes `gpuv2` (dash removed). scheduler affinity checks are exact-match on annotation so those pods don't count as colocatable -> spread/binpacking fails -> fragmentation -> evictions.

mika: ugh. so it's an annotation canonicalization change. did the syncer rollout go out as a canary?

opsbot: deploy-bot: label-syncer 2.1.0 canary deployed to eu-west1 at 06:05 UTC. Health: 77% success across nodes, auto-rollback not triggered (policy: gradual).

alex: immediate mitigation options:
- revert syncer in eu-west1 (fast, but rollback might touch many nodes)
- make scheduler accept both variants (regex fallback) — quicker code change but must be rolled safely
- temporarily increase warmpool size to reduce preempt pressure

priyanka: I've opened issue + PR: #1422 to add fallback regex and telemetry for annotation mismatches. also added a one-off job to patch node annotations for the cohort to the old format for now.

mika: good. i'll scale warmpool +15 nodes in eu-west1 and raise temporary alert for evictions_per_min > 5 for 10m. can we coordinate rollback window if hotfix not ready?

priyanka: scheduling rollback at 22:00 UTC if PR not merged and hotfix not on canary. added runbook steps for node-annotation patch and scheduler regex toggle.

alex: i'll open the PR for scheduler change and also a small canary of the node-patch job. pushing now. will post progress here. :thumbsup:

mika: thanks — monitoring. will report if eviction rate drops after the manual node patch. :eyes:
